appeal_01.text: Zor ki appeal! Poori team chilla rahi hai!

appeal_02.text: How's that?! Umpire soch rahe hain...

appeal_03.text: Pad pe laga! Kya yeh out hai?!

appeal_04.text: Saari duniya ki nazar umpire ki ungli pe!

appeal_05.text: Appeal itni zor ki, ki pados ke gaon tak awaaz gayi!

beaten_01.text: Oye! Beaten! Gend aur bat mein do kilometre ka faasla!

beaten_02.text: Chhoo ke nikal gayi, jaise pehla pyaar!

beaten_03.text: Kya gend hai! Batsman ko pata hi nahi chala.

beaten_04.text: Outside edge ko salaam karke nikal gayi!

beaten_05.text: Bat ghuma diya, gend ne haath hila diya!

beaten_06.text: Itni swing, jaise mele ka jhoola!

beaten_07.text: Bach gaya! Aaj kismat saath hai.

betweenOvers_01.text: Cricket ek kavita hai, doston... har gend ek nayi pankti.

betweenOvers_02.text: Jaise chai bina adrak ke adhoori, waise match bina chhakke ke!

betweenOvers_03.text: Pitch pe ghaas kam, khiladiyon mein josh zyaada!

betweenOvers_04.text: Bowler ki mehnat, batsman ki himmat... yahi toh cricket hai!

betweenOvers_05.text: Khel mein jo darr gaya, samjho woh haar gaya!

betweenOvers_07.text: Aasmaan saaf, maidaan hara, aur dil mein toofan!

betweenOvers_08.text: Ek over mein zindagi badal jaati hai, guru!

bowled_02.text: Gilli udd gayi, jaise shaadi mein pataakha!

bowled_03.text: Stumps bikhar gaye! Ghar wapas jao, bhaiya!

bowled_04.text: Darwaza khula chhoda, aur chor andar aa gaya! Bowled!

bowled_05.text: Oye hoye! Middle stump ne cartwheel maar diya!

bowled_06.text: Bat aur pad ke beech se, seedha stumps! Kya gend hai!

bowled_07.text: Clean bowled! Jaise sabzi kaat di ho!

bowled_08.text: Timber! Lakdi ka dher laga diya!

caught_01.text: Pakad liya! Haath mein gend, aur gale mein maala!

caught_02.text: Upar gayi, neeche aayi, aur seedha jholi mein! Out!

caught_03.text: Catch! Jaise maa ne garam roti thaali mein rakh di!

caught_04.text: Shot toh bada tha, par fielder usse bhi bada nikla!

caught_05.text: Hawa mein gend... aur pakdi gayi! Bas, khel khatam!

caught_06.text: Chhakka maarne chala tha, catch de baitha!

caught_07.text: Safe hands! Jaise bank ka locker!

caught_08.text: Oye! Kya catch hai! Yeh fielder nahi, magnet hai!

caught_09.text: Seedha fielder ke haath mein, jaise address likh ke bheja ho!

dot_01.text: Koi run nahi. Bowler ne taala laga diya.

dot_03.text: Rok diya. Deewar ki tarah khada hai.

dot_04.text: Kuch nahi hua... toofan se pehle ki khamoshi.

dot_05.text: Achhi gend, achha defence. Barabar ki takkar.

dot_07.text: Bat neeche, gend wahin. Koi run nahi.

dot_08.text: Ek aur khaali gend. Pressure badh raha hai, guru.

dropped_01.text: Arre arre arre! Chhod diya! Haath mein aayi aur nikal gayi!

dropped_02.text: Gend makkhan thi kya? Phisal gayi!

dropped_03.text: Drop! Yeh catch nahi, yeh toh dil tootna tha!

dropped_04.text: Jeevan daan mil gaya! Ab dekhte hain kya karta hai.

dropped_05.text: Haathon mein chhed hai kya, bhai?

dropped_06.text: Itna aasaan catch, aur zameen pe! Haaye rabba!

dropped_07.text: Gend ne haath se shake-hand kiya aur chali gayi!

dropped_08.text: Catches jitwaate hain match, aur yeh toh gira diya!

edgeFour_01.text: Haha! Kismat ka chauka! Edge laga aur gend nikal gayi!

edgeFour_02.text: Bat ka kona, aur chaar run! Upar waala meherbaan!

edgeFour_04.text: Isko kehte hain jugaad ka chauka!

edgeFour_05.text: Gend ne bat ko chhua, aur bhaag gayi slips ke beech se!

four_01.text: Chaar run! Gend aise bhaagi jaise ghar pe biryani bani ho!

four_02.text: Gap dhoondha, aur gap mein ghus gaya! Four!

four_03.text: Fielder dekhta reh gaya, gend boundary chhoo gayi!

four_04.text: Kya timing hai guru! Makhan mein chhuri!

four_05.text: Saanp ki tarah sarakti hui, seedha rope tak!

four_06.text: Chauka! Aur fielder ki saans phool gayi!

four_07.text: Oye! Yeh toh express train thi, koi station nahi ruki!

four_08.text: Boundary pe dastak di, darwaza khul gaya! Four!

four_09.text: Shot mein itni class, jaise suit pehen ke khel raha ho!

four_10.text: Chaar run, aur bowler ke chehre pe baarah baj gaye!

four_12.text: Gend ko GPS laga ke bheja hai, seedha gap mein!

hatTrick_01.text: Hat-trick! Teen gend, teen wicket! Itihaas ban gaya!

hatTrick_02.text: Oye hoye! Hat-trick! Yeh bowler nahi, jaadugar hai!

hatTrick_03.text: Ek, do, teen! Hat-trick! Stadium paagal ho gaya!

hatTrick_04.text: Hat-trick! Aaj toh bowler ke ghar Diwali hai!

lastOver_01.text: Aakhri over! Dil ki dhadkan stadium mein sunai de rahi hai!

lastOver_02.text: Chhe gend, aur saari kahaani baaki!

lastOver_03.text: Yahi woh pal hai jahan hero bante hain!

lastOver_04.text: Nakhoon chabaane ka time aa gaya, doston!

lastOver_05.text: Aakhri over, aur saans rok ke baitho!

lbw_01.text: Ungli upar! LBW! Seedha saamne fasa!

lbw_02.text: Pad pe laga, aur umpire ne faisla suna diya! Out!

lbw_03.text: Plumb! Jaise taraazu ka kaanta, ekdum seedha!

lbw_04.text: LBW! Pair aage kiya, aur fas gaya!

lbw_05.text: Wicket ke saamne khade the, aur wicket le gayi!

lost_01.text: Haar gaye... par sher ki tarah lade!

lost_02.text: Aaj din unka tha. Kal hamara hoga, guru!

lost_03.text: Haar jeet toh chalti rehti hai, khel dil se khela!

lost_04.text: Thoda sa chooke, bas! Agli baar dho daalenge!

lost_05.text: Maidaan mein haare, dil mein nahi!

misfield_01.text: Fumble! Gend ne fielder ko chakma de diya!

misfield_02.text: Taangon ke beech se! Oye hoye, misfield!

misfield_03.text: Fielder jhuka, gend nikal gayi, jaise machhli haath se!

misfield_04.text: Do fielder, ek gend, aur dono ne ek doosre ko dekha!

misfield_05.text: Extra run ka tohfa! Shukriya, fielder saab!

misfield_06.text: Gend pakadne gaye the, gend ne unhe pakad liya!

noBall_01.text: No ball! Free hit aa raha hai!

noBall_02.text: Pair line ke paar! No ball!

noBall_03.text: No ball! Bowler ne galti ki, batsman ki chaandi!

noBall_04.text: Oye! Kamar se upar! No ball!

playedOn_01.text: Arre! Khud hi stumps pe kheench li!

playedOn_02.text: Andar ka edge, aur apne hi ghar mein aag!

playedOn_03.text: Kismat kharaab! Gend bat se lagi aur stumps ko chhoo gayi.

playedOn_04.text: Apne hi pair pe kulhaadi maar li, guru!

quick20_01.text: Kya tez innings hai! Run aise aa rahe hain jaise baarish!

quick20_02.text: Yeh batsman aaj rukne waala nahi!

quick20_04.text: Bowlers ki shaamat aa gayi aaj!

six_01.text: Oye hoye! Yeh gend nahi, guided missile thi, seedha stands mein!

six_02.text: Batsman ne aise maara, jaise dhobi kapde dhota hai... dho daala!

six_03.text: Balle balle! Chhakka! Gend gayi chaand ki sair pe!

six_04.text: Uda diya! Jaise patang kat ke aasmaan mein chali jaaye!

six_05.text: Yeh shot nahi tha guru, yeh toh shaadi ka band baaja tha! Chhakka!

six_06.text: Gend ne ticket kaata, aur seedha crowd ke beech jaa baithi!

six_07.text: Oye mere sher! Kya maara hai, kya maara hai!

six_08.text: Bowler soch raha tha yorker daalunga, batsman ne usse lassi bana ke pee liya!

six_09.text: Chak de phatte! Chhe run, aur stadium hil gaya!

six_10.text: Gend ko passport chahiye tha, itni door gayi hai!

six_11.text: Aisa maara jaise tandoor se garam roti nikli ho... seedha boundary paar!

six_12.text: Bowler ki line, batsman ki mehfil! Chhakka!

six_13.text: Upar, upar, aur upar... gayi! Bye bye gend!

six_14.text: Oye hoye! Isko kehte hain bat se kavita likhna!

sledge_01.text: Oho! Aankhon aankhon mein baatein ho rahi hain!

sledge_02.text: Garmaa garmi! Yeh match ab personal ho gaya!

sledge_03.text: Bowler ne kuch kaha... batsman ne bat se jawaab diya!

sledge_04.text: Chai mein shakkar kam, maidaan mein mirchi zyaada!

sledge_05.text: Hehe! Thoda masala bhi zaroori hai, guru!

start_01.text: Namaskar, sat sri akal, aur swagat hai! Aaj ka match dhamaakedaar hoga!

start_02.text: Stadium bhara hua, josh bhara hua! Shuru karte hain!

start_03.text: Oye hoye! Kya maahaul hai! Aaj toh chhakke barsenge!

start_04.text: Pads pehno, bat uthao, aur ho jao shuru!

threeWickets_01.text: Teesra wicket! Yeh bowler aaj aag ugal raha hai!

threeWickets_02.text: Teen wicket! Batting line-up mein bhookamp!

threeWickets_03.text: Ek ke baad ek! Jaise domino gir rahe hain!

threeWickets_04.text: Teen shikaar! Sher aaj bhookha hai!

wide_01.text: Wide! Itni door ki gend, ki pados waale stadium mein jaati.

wide_02.text: Wide ball. Muft ka run, shukriya!

wide_03.text: Line bhatak gayi bowler ki! Wide!

won_01.text: Jeet gaye! Balle balle! Aaj raat bhangra hoga!

won_02.text: Match khatam, jeet hamari! Chak de phatte!

won_03.text: Oye hoye! Kya jeet hai! Dil garden garden ho gaya!

won_04.text: Jeet ka swaad, jaise sarson ka saag aur makki di roti!

won_05.text: Champion! Champion! Poora stadium naach raha hai!

won_06.text: Yeh jeet yaad rakhi jaayegi, doston!
